The architecture is stunning, especially the famous stone pagodas and the elegant stairways leading up to the main halls. The temple grounds are peaceful and well preserved, making it a perfect place to experience traditional Korean Buddhist culture and history. It’s also a…

1401.a: Geoje Maengjongjuk Theme Park, 700 Geojebuk-ro, Hacheong-myeon, Geoje-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, South Korea
1401.aj: 孟宗竹テーマパーク ７００ Geojebuk-ro, Hacheong-myeon, Geoje-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, 韓国

rv.t: There are not much things to see here. The best time to come for the visit are during spring and autumn to hike, because the park is build at the hillside, so you are required to follow the pathway to go up to the hill.

Rating: ★★★★★ I recently visited Geoje Maengjongjuk Theme Park and had an absolutely amazing experience! This park is a true gem, offering a unique blend of natural beauty and engaging activities that make it a must-visit destination. The bamboo forest is nothing short of spectacular. Walking through the towering bamboo groves felt like stepping into another world. The serene and peaceful atmosphere was incredibly…

Fun bamboo hike. Can be a bit crowded and hard to navigate with the large groups that tend to take up the whole pathway. Has a little zip line but its definitely for kids. The views are fantastic though and if you have it in you to make it to the top it is definitely worth the views.

1402.a: South Korea, Gyeongsangnam-do, Geoje-si, Nambu-myeon, Jeogu-ri, 450-1 근포마을땅굴
1402.aj: 韓国 Gyeongsangnam-do, Geoje-si, Nambu-myeon, Jeogu-ri, ４５０−１ 근포마을땅굴

rv.t: Basically just a cave for taking photos. Some of the visitors here were quite rude. Since there was no staff managing the entrance, people taking photos from inside the cave would get upset whenever others walked in and accidentally blocked the light from the entrance. It made the whole experience feel a bit uncomfortable and confusing. Honestly, the little dogs wandering around nearby were more interesting than the…

Good place for another interesting sight, there is a bit of a wait to enter the caverns, which allows you about 3 minutes of privacy to take some great photos. It is a damp place. There is a little walking before you get there. After you park your vehicle, just look for the painted fishes on the asphalt road to the caverns. It is FREE.
Good if you don't have to wait in line too long to take pictures

1403.a: Historic Park of Geoje POW Camp, 61 계룡로 Geoje-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, South Korea
1403.aj: 巨済島 捕虜収容所 遺跡公園 ６１ 계룡로 Geoje-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, 韓国
1403.ed: Korean War prisoner camp turned museum, with dioramas & exhibits on the daily life of captives.

rv.t: A must visit in order to understand a part of what the korean people went through. Taking our time and the visit took us around 2 hours. 'Real life' exhibits showing life in the camp for men and women. Exhibition of tanks ,helicopter and actual remains of the camp. Very moving

Theme park with rather stereotypical dioramas scattered with historical photos and a variety of war items on display, some with no substantial connection to the camp. Unfortunately, the opportunity to develop a systematic didactical and scientific based approach has been missed leaving the visitors with a random caleidoscope of scattered facts. Also, the exhibits are not particularly well maintained.

It’s definitely worth the visit if you like to learn more about the Korean war. This place is very informative but it lacks translation here and there. It could also use a little touch up to make it more attractive for the public. Problem: tickets are sold at the entrance via an automated system but it’s only in Korean! You can’t switch the language to English. Parking is not free and costs 2,000 Won. Entrance fee…

1404.a: Sinseondae Observatory, 산252-1 Yongho-dong, Nam-gu, Busan, South Korea
1404.aj: 神仙台展望台 산252-1 Yongho-dong, Nam-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: My favorite spot to refresh. Nice view of busan port scenery.

ちょっとした山登りの後に絶景が待ってます。 この場所から歩いて２０分くらい山を下ると、駐車場があり、自分はそこまでタクシーできました。 タクシーできた後、ここにタクシーを呼んでも来てくれないことがあるので注意のほどお願いします。 (自分は呼んでもダメだったので、近くのバス停まで３０分くらい歩きました) 話を戻して、山を登り切ったところは港が見え、その奥にはリゾートマンションが立ち並ぶ絶景が見れます。 この地域は海沿いで景色が良い場所がいくつもありますが、その中でも結構マイナーな方ですので、他の観光客が来ない様な絶景ポイントに行きたい方にお勧めします。😚 私が行った時は天気が悪くイマイチな景色でしたが、再度訪れてみたい場所です
정자랑 화장실이 생각보다 깔끔했습니다 정자에서 정상으로 올라가봤지만 초소와 경고표지판뿐이었어요

1405.a: Windy Hill, Galgot-ri, Nambu-myeon, Geoje-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, South Korea
1405.aj: 風の丘 Galgot-ri, Nambu-myeon, Geoje-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, 韓国
1405.ed: Landmark hill with mountain & ocean views, a quaint beach with amenities & an old windmill.

rv.t: This is a cute hill where you can take plenty of Instagram-worthy photos. It’s a short, easy hike up to the windmill, and the views from the top are pretty awesome. There are benches along the way if you want to rest or take in the scenery. It was super muggy so we expected some winds but it wasn't windy at all. :) Definitely check this place out—and enjoy a meal at one of the many restaurants at the base of the…

Eh, so-so. Our family loves nature and being out and about, but Windy Hill is just that; a windy hill. It’s crowded and there’s honestly not much to see. The view is lovely but so are all the coastal views in Geoje, so I’m not sure it worth the traffic jams and heat (during summer) to climb up there for a pic of a windmill. I’d say go if you’ve got nothing else to do :)

The attraction itself is free to enter; it’s just the parking costs 3000won. Payment is via cash or bank transfer if the parking attendant was there. We arrived on a Chuseok holiday at around 9am and the parking was still plenty. We spent around an hour there enjoying the beautiful weather and windy breeze; it’s perfect! The crowd started to grow big when we left. Encourage to come as early as you can to avoid the…

1406.a: 구조라 해수욕장, 500-1 Gujora-ri, Irun-myeon, Geoje-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, South Korea
1406.aj: 구조라 해수욕장, ５００−１ Gujora-ri, Irun-myeon, Geoje-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, 韓国

rv.t: This is one of the best sand beaches on Geoje! If you go in the summer there will be a small fee, tents set up, food sales, etc and it’s very busy. That’s usually July-end of August. The rest of the year it’s so nice and quiet! The water is cold but blue and clear. We love going here to build sand castles and swim. The parking is really convenient! They have clean bathrooms too.
Very good and clean place. not crowded, can enjoy like private place.
A cool beach to hangout .It's quite windy and have a fishing harbour nearby.Often sand get carried away in the wind and hence recommended to use glass

1407.a: Maemi Castle, Bokhang-gil, Jangmok-myeon, Geoje-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, South Korea
1407.aj: 蝉城 Bokhang-gil, Jangmok-myeon, Geoje-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, 韓国

rv.t: Maemiseong Fortress is a wonderful place to stop by on the way to Busan. The coastal scenery is beautiful, and the stone fortress built by one person makes the place even more unique. Walking along the sea while enjoying the fresh breeze was very relaxing. It’s a great spot for photos, and the atmosphere is peaceful. If you're traveling in this area, I highly recommend taking some time to visit.
It is very relaxing and very easy to get. No entrance fee. There are a lot of tourist shops around . Coffee shops lot.

The castle may seem simple and incomplete, but it’s amazing when you learn that all of this was built by just one man. It’s not big but has a cafe nearby as well as various shops. Great place for photos with lovely sea views.

1408.ed: Large island with a pebble beach & coastal national park featuring a picturesque, rocky isle.
1408.edj: 小石の海岸と、美しい岩肌の島で知られる海沿いの自然公園がある、大きな島。

rv.t: This island is outstanding. It is easy to get to, has great beaches (both sandy and rock), nearby Island attractions like Windy Hill and Oedo Island and the food it delicious. You can take the bus from Seoul and enjoy everything. I will be going back!
One of the Best scenic island after Jeju and it’s good to use own vehicles compare to poor public transport. Many places roads are too narrow and frequent traffic jams can occur.
Very nice countryside town with clean air, nice environment and locals. Loved it.

1409.a: Japan, 〒150-0022 Tokyo, Shibuya, Ebisuminami, 1 Chome−13−13番地3 GOLD3階 恵比寿の焚き火Cafe&Bar CityCamp
1409.aj: 〒150-0022 東京都渋谷区恵比寿南１丁目１３−13番地3 GOLD3階 恵比寿の焚き火Cafe&Bar CityCamp
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
1409.ed: Visitors say this bar offers a unique atmosphere with a real bonfire, creating a camp-like ambiance perfect for enjoying cocktails and craft beers. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the staff's kind and helpful service, especially for events. Others mention it's a quiet and comfortable spot to relax and enjoy drinks.
1409.edj: このバーを訪れた人は、本物の焚き火があるユニークな雰囲気を評価しており、キャンプのような空間でカクテルやクラフトビールを楽しめるというクチコミがあります。また、手頃な価格設定や、イベントの際に特に親切で丁寧なスタッフの対応も高く評価されています。その他には、静かで快適にリラックスしてドリンクを楽しめる場所だという声もあります。

rv.t: It’s a short walk uphill from Ebisu Station. I was a little disappointed that the alcoholic drinks were served in plastic cups, but I really liked the atmosphere. I visited on a Wednesday night, and it was pretty lively. I’d definitely stop by again if I’m having dinner nearby.
The cost of junk food is high, and it appears that they were seeking monetary gain. We aim to avoid repeat customers.
Nice and cozy place to chill!! Recommended 👌🏼

1410.a: Japan, 〒399-9301 Nagano, Kitaazumi District, Hakuba, 宇奈月町黒部字黒部奥山 Karamatsudake Summit Hut, 黒部奥山国有林36イ林小班
1410.aj: 〒399-9301 長野県北安曇郡白馬村宇奈月町黒部字黒部奥山 唐松岳頂上山荘 黒部奥山国有林36イ林小班
1410.nb: 字黒部奥山 黒部 宇奈月町

rv.t: Agree with the other contributors about the poor service here. Rooms were decent enough but the service was quite a turn off, especially from the slightly older man. No drinking water for guests and meals were quite rushed. The views were gorgeous though, just a pity it didn't cheer up the staff there.

-16000 yen per person include dinner(5pm) and breakfast(6am) can refill rice. - officer tell me :room about 60 people per room , some have small group depend on you choose ;first come first serve -private room add 18000 yen per group - they have blankets and futon ,it work for deep sleep - toilet : very good , minimal smell

I've stayed at maybe 20 mountain huts over the past 2 years, but this is the most overpriced mountain hut I've ever experienced. - 12,000 yen for a room without meals, without water. - 2,000 yen extra for same-day bookings, not advised over the phone. - Only water available is 600 yen for 500ml at the vending machine. - Many of the staff were rude, they seem like they're unhappy with their job. + Location is…

1411.a: Okadaya Shinjuku, オカダヤTFビル 3 Chome-23-17 Shinjuku, Shinjuku City, Tokyo 160-0022, Japan
1411.aj: 〒160-0022 東京都新宿区新宿３丁目２３−１７ オカダヤTFビル 新宿オカダヤ本店
1411.ed: Visitors say this craft store offers an overwhelming and diverse selection of fabrics, yarns, and sewing supplies, with many unique and hard-to-find items. They also highlight the helpful and knowledgeable staff, who provide excellent advice and guidance. Some reviews mention the staff can be impolite.
1411.edj: この手芸店を訪れたユーザーのクチコミでは、生地や毛糸、裁縫用品の品揃えが圧倒的で、他では見つけにくい珍しい商品も多いと評価されています。また、親身で知識豊富なスタッフが的確なアドバイスや案内をしてくれるという声も多くあります。 一方で、スタッフの対応が丁寧でないというクチコミも一部見られます。

rv.t: Okadaya Shinjuku was a really fun stop because there was such a wide mix of things to look through. I kept finding new sections I hadn’t expected, so it never felt boring. If you enjoy browsing and discovering random little treasures, this place is easy to spend time in and I’d happily come back.

Amazing store for seamstresses, quilters, knitters and embroiderers. The selection is huge, the crew is nice and patient, the overall store is clean and beautiful with many samplers for our inspiration. Highly recommended ❤️
You will find all you need for sewing here. Different floor offers different materials, make sure to check which floor you will be on. Japanese textiles and fabrics are nice for souvenirs too.

1412.a: Japan, 〒329-2763 Tochigi, Nasushiobara, Iguchi, 548-350 古代ソマチッド温泉大鷹の湯
1412.aj: 〒329-2763 栃木県那須塩原市井口５４８−３５０ 古代ソマチッド温泉大鷹の湯
1412.ed: Upscale hot spring hotel with subdued rooms, some with open-air baths, plus dining & a spa area.
1412.edj: 高級感あふれる温泉旅館。落ち着いた雰囲気の客室（一部は露天風呂付き）を備えている。レストランとスパもある。

rv.t: Traditional Japanese hotel near Nasu with great food; great onsen and lovely staff. We came here as a big group overnight and had a lovely evening. The food was locally sourced and beautifully prepared. There are a number of baths both inside and outside with a lovely silky water. |A very pleasant stay and would definitely revisit.
It's a fantastic place for onsen lover.
日帰り 利用時間が短いのでホームページで確認要 飲泉可（フロント近く） 貴重品ボックス無料あり（更衣室に入る前） シャンプー、化粧水等あり ドライヤーあり 水道水あり 売店で入浴剤などちょっとしたお土産が買える。 紛うことなき良泉。 癖が少なくトロトロ。本物のかけ流し。 わざわざ行く価値があると思います。 どこかスピリチュアル系の感じがしますが、至って普通の綺麗な施設です。 （メモ）

1413.a: Aji-no-Yohei, 7番地 Kamininomachi, Takayama, Gifu 506-0845, Japan
1413.aj: 〒506-0845 岐阜県高山市上二之町7番地 高山 飛騨牛専門レストラン 味の与平
1413.ed: Sake brewery featuring a casual steakhouse serving Hida beef dishes, plus soba & tempura.
1413.edj: 酒造店に併設された格式ばらないレストラン。ステーキをはじめ、飛騨牛を使用した料理が名物。そばや天ぷらも提供する。

rv.t: Aji No Yohei — a well-known Hida beef restaurant in Takayama, Gifu, Japan: ⸻ 🥩 • Aji No Yohei is a popular casual dining spot specializing in Hida beef (飛騨牛) — one of Takayama’s signature local delicacies — often featured as set meals or steak grilled at your table. ￼ • It sits within Takayama’s old town atmosphere and is run by a sake brewery, adding local charm and a chance to pair meals with regional sake. ￼ ⸻ ⭐…

Would remmend if you want to try hida beef in Takayama. Presentation and quality was great. We made a reservation so we were taken to the 2nd floor. It's a smokey room that fits around 10 tables and smells of bbq. The beef was soft, delicious and will melt in your mouth. I am not a fan of AT wagyu, but this was a different experience. The sake flight was so good I ordered a bottle of the Yotsubosi sake afterwards…

Aji-no-Yohei (味の与平) – Hida Beef in Takayama 4 stars out of 5. Lovely spot in Takayama’s old town, run by the historic Funasaka sake brewery. The real highlight is being able to enjoy premium Hida beef in multiple styles at the same table — we had teppanyaki grilling and sukiyaki together, which is perfect for groups or families where everyone has their own preference. The tender, well-marbled meat shines in both…

1413.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1414.a: Monet's Pond, 関市板取白谷, Seki, Gifu 501-2901, Japan
1414.aj: 〒501-2901 岐阜県関市モネの池 関市板取白谷
1414.ed: Scenic pond known for its clear water, water lilies, koi fish & colorful, seasonal foliage.
1414.edj: 透き通った水、鯉、スイレンで知られる風光明媚な池。秋には色鮮やかな紅葉が楽しめる。

rv.t: I visited in mid-April. It's just one small pond and that’s it. There are some koi fish swimming around, but the colors aren't as vibrant as I expected. I feel like the promotional photos were heavily edited to look much better than the reality.

If you try to come here after seeing videos online you will be very disappointed. The pond is very dull looking and greenish, can hardly see any fish and there was a weird smell when we went there in March. I'm not sure if the look of the pond or smell is gone at other times during the year but I wasn't too impressed.

The pond is small but beautiful, especially at the spot where the carp swim by and you can see the quartz sand at the bottom. On a sunny day, the fish swimming gracefully with their shadows in the water looks almost magical. It was nice to learn that the pond is fed by natural spring water. We visited on a Saturday in mid July, and it was crowded and hot. The free parking opposite the road was full, so we park at a…

1415.a: Udatsu-lined streetscape, 1959-1 加治屋町 Mino, Gifu 501-3701, Japan
1415.aj: 〒501-3701 岐阜県美濃市加治屋町１９５９−１ うだつの上がる町並み
1415.ed: Cluster of Edo-era residences with ornate details, now home to shops selling sake, paper & sweets.
1415.edj: 華やかな装飾が施された江戸時代の家々が並ぶ町並み。現在は酒屋、和紙店、菓子店が軒を連ねる。

rv.t: Very great place. A beautiful townscape, authentic but very quiet. You can explore without crowds. I recommend crossing the small town mountain, visiting the outlook and crossing the bridge in the north. I had a very nice day in this town. A real nice insider tip.

Well preserved streets here, with lots of history on display and helpful friendly people. Plenty of paper crafts and shops to enjoy, and historical buildings to look around. There is ample parking nearby, so no need to drive down the street. There is also some good sake to be found here. Spend the day and enjoy a visit. Recommended.

Beautiful area to walk around in. Not only are there Udatsu ornamental rooftops, but there are quite many shops in the area as well. Be very careful, because you will spend a lot of money. The articles are not overpriced. But they are almost exclusively hand-made, and you can buy them nowhere but in Mino. There are beautiful paper items, like fans, notebooks, covers and all sorts of things, there is Sake, Japanese…

1416.a: Katsuo Shokudo, GranDuo渋谷 B1 7-12 Uguisudanicho, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0032, Japan
1416.aj: 〒150-0032 東京都渋谷区鶯谷町７−１２ GranDuo渋谷 B1 かつお食堂
1416.ed: Diners like this cafe's freshly shaved bonito flakes, which are described as fragrant and flavorful, and the delicious bonito karaage. They also highlight the friendly staff and the unique, intimate atmosphere. Some reviews mention the service can be impolite.
1416.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、香りが良く風味豊かと評される削りたてのかつお節や、美味しいかつおの唐揚げが高く評価されています。また、親しみやすいスタッフと、ユニークでこぢんまりとした雰囲気も好評のようです。 一方で、スタッフの対応が丁寧ではないという意見も一部見受けられます。

rv.t: One of the most memorable meals of my life, it all felt like a warm hug. The nostalgia and comfort was the main ingredient. Felt like we were invited to someone's house for breakfast, everything felt so freshly made and peak quality. If you like rice and bonito would definitely recommend this meal.

Incredible quality TKG and a perfect way to start the day. The smokiness and umami of the freshly shaved bonito flakes has a distinct sharpness that cuts through the richness of the egg yolk and that is balanced by the neutral rice. Every bite is wonderfully savoury and accentuated by the fluffy yet firm mouthfeel of the rice, with the selection of pickles refreshing the palate between each bite. Great spot for…

Watching the owner freshly shave Bonito flakes for your meal is one of the best experiences! I will recommend adding the kaarage to your set meal! Absolutely delicious! Something to highlight: if you made a booking, please arrive on time! The place is small and food is all prepared by hand. If you did not make a reservation, be prepared to wait till seats are available.

1417.a: Fujiya, 第5富士商事ビル １階 24-4 Sakuragaokacho, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0031, Japan
1417.aj: 〒150-0031 東京都渋谷区桜丘町２４−４ 第5富士商事ビル １階 富士屋本店ワインバー
catj: モダン居酒屋レストラン
1417.ed: Cozy European restaurant offering wood-fired pizza, pasta & other mains, plus a robust wine list.
1417.edj: 西洋料理を提供する居心地の良いレストラン。薪窯で焼いたピザ、パスタなどの料理のほか、種類豊富なワインも味わえる。

rv.t: Bustling Italian-oriented dinner spot with bar seating, two person table tops and a few clusters of group tables. Lots of affordable drink options, I chose the craft lemon sour which was sweet and went well with the pizza. The pizzas were thin crust with fresh toppings. Highly recommend the cinnamon-apple dessert pizza!
Nice food super great interior environment
Good udon with tempura.

1417.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 17:00

1418.a: Chacha Koubou Kiyosumi, 1 Chome-5-4 Miyoshi, Koto City, Tokyo 135-0022, Japan
1418.aj: 〒135-0022 東京都江東区三好１丁目５−４ 茶々工房 kiyosumi
1418.ed: Diners like this cafe's exquisitely fluffy matcha pancakes, which are prepared right before their eyes, and the wide variety of high-quality, pesticide-free Japanese teas. They also highlight the rich matcha flavor in both the pancakes and drinks, with options like matcha butter and matcha mont blanc toppings. Guests mention the calm atmosphere and the engaging experience of watching their order…
1418.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、目の前で調理される、とろけるようなふわふわの抹茶パンケーキと、高品質で無農薬の日本茶が種類豊富に用意されている点が評価されています。パンケーキとドリンクの両方で抹茶の風味が豊かに感じられることも特徴で、抹茶バターや抹茶モンブランなどのトッピングも選べます。落ち着いた雰囲気の中で、注文したものが作られる様子を見られることも、利用した人の満足度を高めているようです。

rv.t: The chef prepares exquisitely fluffy pancakes right before your eyes, and their house-made lemon jam is simply divine.

We had the chestnut pancake and the one with the custard. I cant say that it was the most delicious pancake that i ever ate but it was tasty and the matcha was good quality and a little bit bitter. Note; the waiting time for the pancakes was very long, we waited around half an hour and it was cash only and very expensive.

Yummy pancakes! Loved the atmosphere of this place - chill music while you get to watch your pancakes being made directly in front of you. They're not quick to make but the wait makes them all the more satisfying 😋 The matcha custard cream and other toppings were even more delicious than I hoped for! 💚

1418.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 12:00

1419.a: Harajuku Gyozarou, 6 Chome-2-4 Jingumae, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0001, Japan
1419.aj: 〒150-0001 東京都渋谷区神宮前６丁目２−４ 原宿餃子樓
1419.ed: Intimate counter-serve with limited seating doling out boiled & fried dim sum, plus beer & sake.
1419.edj: 水餃子や焼き餃子と一緒にビールや日本酒を楽しめる居心地の良い店。座席数は少なめ。カウンター席あり。

rv.t: If you’re looking for great gyoza in the Harajuku/Omotesando area, check this place out. We visited on a Saturday, and like many popular spots in Japan, there was a line. It moved steadily, and it was well worth it. The restaurant is centered around a large U shaped counter that wraps around the kitchen, so you can watch the cooks making gyoza right in front of you. There are also a few small tables along the side…

I rarely leave negative reviews, but our experience at Harajuku Gyozarou was honestly one of the biggest disappointments of our trip to Tokyo. We came here expecting a simple, authentic, no-frills gyoza spot that focused on quality food and warm Japanese hospitality. Gwangan Bridge is a stunning suspension bridge in South Korea and famous for its night time LED light show and iconic views of Busan's coastline. 1439.aj: 国際市場 ５５ Gukjesijang 2-gil, Jung-gu, Busan, 韓国
1439.ed: Lively, sprawling marketplace with vendors selling street food, home goods & souvenirs.
1439.edj: 屋台の食べ物、家庭用品、土産品などを売る業者が集まり、雑多で活気あふれる市場。

rv.t: An authentic Korean local market that left a great impression on us. Everything was well organized, clean and fresh. We visited in the evening, so many shops were already closed, but there were still plenty of food stalls, grocery stores, and snack shops open, whatever you need, you can probably find it here. The market is very large, so be prepared to spend some time exploring and searching for what you want…
Massive marketplace spread across several blocks, and some within buildings, several floors. Packed with a lot of interesting items. There is also a huge food section

Sprawling market with amazing food and souvenirs! 🥟 Prepared food, just sit down at the bar 🥦 Fresh produce for sale 👕 Souvenirs, although largely bulk standard ones ❗ This is the place to have milmyeon, a unique Busan dish. It's a twist on Naemgmyeon, but made with wheat noodles instead, as wheat was present during the war in rations. Check out the nearby provisional capital building to learn more!
